coder_notes: Imaging-only companion study; the only registered intervention is the diagnostic tracer. Niraparib is not a registered intervention here but the arm descriptions say participants start it (companion treatment trial), so it is listed as soc_backbone and is not treated as a candidate of this record. Target engagement coded no because niraparib is not a candidate in this record (FTT uptake changes after the PARP inhibitor are imaging outcomes of the tracer study). control_arm_from_other_arms: two OTHER-type cohorts, neither works as a control.
